banner.finishing: Sending the offline work to the server ({{count}} left) — new actions wait until this PC is back on the web app.
banner.notAvailable: Settings, users, supplier settlement and catalog changes are not available offline.

pair.title: Pair this PC with the web app
pair.intro: After pairing, the shop works in the web app and this PC keeps a copy of the shop so it can keep selling when the internet is down. An admin of the shop signs in once.
pair.done: Paired as PC {{deviceNo}} of {{shopName}}. The app restarts on the standby screen.

standby.intro: This is PC {{deviceNo}} of the shop. Work in the web app while the internet works.
standby.copyOld: (older than a day — check the totals after)
standby.held: {{count}} offline item(s) from this PC are held for review on the web app. Do not collect them again:
standby.workOfflineHint: Available after 30 seconds without the internet, with a ready copy

review.title: Offline work to review
review.adminsOnly: This page is only for admins.
review.intro: Work done on a PC while the internet was down that could not be booked by itself.
review.loadFailed: Could not load the review list
review.figuresNote: The PC could not see the web app's and other PCs' sales. The server's figure (the drawer at the time of the count) is the one that will be booked.

confirmText.apply: Book this item now, through the same rules as the web app?
confirmText.dismiss: Drop this item? Nothing will be booked.
confirmText.book_anyway: Book this transfer/recharge as a second, separate one?
